description: This file defines a class 'FilterParser' that safely parses Supabase filter strings into executable functions, with validation to prevent unsafe code execution.

classes.name: FilterParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods to parse and validate Supabase filter strings into safe executable functions.

methods.name: parseFilterString
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a function that applies the filter chain to an RPC object.

methods.name: cleanFilterString
methods.description: Removes comments and whitespace, and trims the filter string.

methods.name: parseFilterChain
methods.description: Splits the filter string into a chain of method calls with validated method names and operators.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Safely parses argument strings into JavaScript values, handling strings, numbers, booleans, nulls, and arrays.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Converts a single argument string into its corresponding JavaScript value, with safety checks.

methods.name: buildFilterFunction
methods.description: Constructs a function that applies the chain of validated method calls to an RPC object.
